# mpfr-random-v1 regression rows for disagreements found by the random differential campaign
# id op rounding precision emin emax tininess a b c n expected flags
# Each row is annotated with the finding it reproduces. A row annotated
# `xfail #N` is a known failure; the smoke run requires exactly the xfail rows
# to fail, so a fixed row loses its marker and stays as a regression test.
# #271 exp2 of an exactly representable subnormal returned +0 (unbounded context)
reg.exp2.exact-subnormal exp2 n 2 - - - -0x1p30 - - 0 0x1p-1073741824 -
# #271 the same with the argument below -2^30
reg.exp2.exact-subnormal-below exp2 z 28 - - - -0x40000001p0 - - 0 0x1p-1073741825 -
# #272 pow of an exact power of two below 2^e_min: (1/4)^(2^29 + 1/2) = 2^-1073741825
reg.pow.exact-subnormal pow n 3 - - - 0x1p-2 0x40000001p-1 - 0 0x1p-1073741825 -
# #272 the same at p = 2, where 2^-1073741825 is half the smallest subnormal (tie to even)
reg.pow.exact-subnormal-tie pow n 2 - - - 0x1p-2 0x40000001p-1 - 0 0x0p0 xu
# #272 and rounded up
reg.pow.exact-subnormal-up pow u 2 - - - 0x1p-2 0x40000001p-1 - 0 0x1p-1073741824 xu
# #278 pown of a value between half and the whole smallest subnormal, rounded toward negative
reg.pown.below-smallest-down pown d 40 - - - 0x3p0 - - -677455689 0x0p0 xu
# #278 at p = 42 the value is between 2^q and 2^(q+1) and rounds down to the smallest subnormal 2^q
reg.pown.below-smallest-down-next pown d 42 - - - 0x3p-1 - - -1835573839 0x1p-1073741864 xu
# #275 hypot of operands with an exponent beyond 2^29 in magnitude, or near the subnormal limit
reg.hypot.exponent-beyond-2e29 hypot n 53 - - - 0x1p-600000000 0x1p-600000000 - 0 0x16a09e667f3bcdp-600000052 x
reg.hypot.exponent-beyond-2e29-unequal hypot n 53 - - - 0x1p-540000000 0x1p-540000001 - 0 0x23c6ef372fe95p-540000049 x
reg.hypot.exponent-beyond-2e29-large hypot n 53 - - - 0x1p600000000 0x1p600000000 - 0 0x16a09e667f3bcdp599999948 x
reg.hypot.near-smallest-normal hypot n 53 - - - 0x1p-1073741700 0x1p-1073741720 - 0 0x20000000001p-1073741741 x
reg.hypot.negligible-subnormal-operand hypot u 53 - - - 0x1p-1073741780 0x1p-1073741860 - 0 0x10000000000001p-1073741832 x
reg.hypot.subnormal-result hypot d 53 - - - 0x3p-1073741860 0x3p-1073741860 - 0 0x10f87p-1073741874 xu
